name: Zoom
label: Zoom — Zoom Meeting API v2
description: Zoom via the official Zoom Meeting API v2. Base https://api.zoom.us/v2. Docs: https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/meetings/. OAuth user or Server-to-Server account token minted outside StudioQuack (JWT apps are retired). Server-to-Server cannot use the `me` keyword — pass a real userId or email. Recordings are personal data. Handler: OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). OUTPUT is {status,http_status,data} or {error}. Inbound webhooks: selecting the :listen operation (listen) via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) + provider signing/verification secret (webhook_secret_token) blocks the canvas INPUT port and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start (or binds to any Activity's MESSAGE Boundary Event).
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Zoom operation. Set operation plus the fields that operation needs. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"create-meeting"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official call to run. EXACT values: create-meeting | get-meeting | list-meetings | update-meeting | delete-meeting | list-registrants | add-registrant | list-recordings | listen. listen (:listen role) is configured on the node via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) for inbound webhooks (blocks the canvas INPUT port). Example: first verb.

schema.label: userId
schema.description: Zoom user id or email. User OAuth may use me; Server-to-Server OAuth must use a real userId or email (docs: https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/using-zoom-apis/). Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: meetingId
schema.description: Meeting id (numeric string). Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: topic
schema.description: Meeting topic. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: email
schema.description: Registrant email. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: first_name
schema.description: Registrant first name. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: type
schema.description: create-meeting: meeting type 1 instant | 2 scheduled (API default) | 3 recurring no fixed time | 8 recurring fixed time. list-meetings: scheduled | live | upcoming | upcoming_meetings | previous_meetings. Example: 2.

schema.label: start_time
schema.description: Meeting start for create-meeting / update-meeting, yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC) or local time with timezone. Needed for scheduled meetings (type 2, and type 8 recurrences); ignored for instant meetings (type 1). Example: 2026-12-01T10:00:00Z.

schema.label: duration
schema.description: Request-body parameter `duration` for operations: create-meeting, update-meeting.

schema.label: timezone
schema.description: Request-body parameter `timezone` for operations: create-meeting, update-meeting.

schema.label: agenda
schema.description: Request-body parameter `agenda` for operations: create-meeting, update-meeting.

schema.label: password
schema.description: Request-body parameter `password` for operation: create-meeting.

schema.label: settings
schema.description: Request-body parameter `settings` for operations: create-meeting, update-meeting.

schema.label: page_size
schema.description: Query-string parameter `page_size` for operations: list-meetings, list-registrants.

schema.label: next_page_token
schema.description: Query-string parameter `next_page_token` for operations: list-meetings, list-registrants.

schema.label: last_name
schema.description: Request-body parameter `last_name` for operation: add-registrant.

schema.label: address
schema.description: Registrant street. add-registrant.

schema.label: city
schema.description: Registrant city. add-registrant.

schema.label: country
schema.description: Registrant country (two-letter). add-registrant. Example: US.

schema.label: zip
schema.description: Registrant postal code. add-registrant.

schema.label: state
schema.description: Registrant state. add-registrant.

schema.label: phone
schema.description: Registrant phone. add-registrant. PII — do not log.

schema.label: org
schema.description: Registrant organization. add-registrant.

schema.label: job_title
schema.description: Registrant job title. add-registrant.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Result object. Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Inbound webhook events (:listen) emit normalized event data on output. Secrets never appear. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Present on HTTP success. EXACT: ok.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: Upstream HTTP status. Example: 200.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the provider, or raw text if not JSON. Never contains secrets.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when INPUT omits operation. EXACT: create-meeting, get-meeting, list-meetings, update-meeting, delete-meeting, list-registrants, add-registrant, list-recordings, listen. Selecting listen (:listen role) reveals webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) and provider verification fields (webhook_secret_token), blocks the canvas INPUT port, and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start or Activity MESSAGE Boundary Event.

configurationParameters.label: Zoom access token
configurationParameters.description: OAuth or Server-to-Server access token minted outside StudioQuack. Header Authorization: Bearer. StudioQuack secret. Never log. Never put on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout for each official HTTPS call. Positive integer. Default 25. 0/blank → 25.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.

configurationParameters.label: Zoom Webhook Secret Token
configurationParameters.description: Zoom App Secret Token used for endpoint.url_validation HMAC challenge and x-zm-signature verification. Never logged.
